blocks.text: If R is an integer, the value at the Rth position in the ordered dataset is the percentile. blocks.title: Steps to calculate percentile with example
blocks.problem: Suppose we have the following dataset representing the heights (cm) of 10 individuals: 160, 162, 168, 165, 170, 175, 172, 178, 180, 182. To calculate the 40th percentile:
steps: Step 1: Arrange the data in ascending order.
Step 2: Determine the total number of observations.
Step 4: Locate the rank in the dataset and interpolate if necessary.
The rank is 4.4, which is not an integer. This means that the 40th percentile lies between 4th (168) and 5th (170) data points.
Percentile value = value at 4th + 0.4 X (value at 5th - value at 4th)
blocks.answer: The 40th percentile value is 168.8. This means that 40% of the observations fall below or equal to 168.8 in this data set.
